provenance_note: Hand-derived from 133.0-B-2 with the field catalogue of docs/03-api-model.md §9.1 (M2 plan D3). The inputs are those of the released cases spp-inv-001, spp-inv-008, spp-inv-010, and spp-idle-005, whose outcomes are unchanged; these cases add the code of the field each error names: the Packet Version Number (code 4, §4.1.3.2.2: a Space Packet has version 000), the Secondary Header Flag (code 48, §4.1.3.3.3.4: 0 for an Idle Packet), and the packet length (code 52, §4.1.2.2: at least 7 octets).

cases.description: Strict: Idle Packet with flag 1 is InvalidField naming secondary_header_flag
Idle Packet of total length 6 is OutOfRange naming packet_len
